verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: BOB Wayfinder Infant Car Seat Adapter for Nuna/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Britax — ~$59.99 (Strolleria). Strolleria review explicitly confirms it 'worked great with our Nuna Pipa aire'.
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: BOB Infant Car Seat Adapter for single/jogging strollers (Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna, 2016+) — $99.99; mounts fit Alterrain & Alterrain PRO.
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct Toyota Tacoma data found. Compact, lightweight (carrier ~6.2 lb sans canopy/inserts) EPP-foam shell with a baseless seat-belt install option, which generally helps tight rear seats / 3-across; no truck-specific seat-to-seat depth, recline-footprint, or CPST Tacoma notes located.

notes: Pipa Aire RX is the seat+RELX base bundle; current street price is $650 across authorized Nuna retailers (Nuna enforces uniform MAP — Nuna's own DTC page was out of stock with no price shown). Lowest in-stock = $650. Seed 'price' field (380) is a low stub MSRP fallback and should be reviewed in integration. Carrier 6.2 lb without canopy/inserts (canopy+inserts add ~2.2 lb). Weight-based recline (no on-seat recline indicator) is the noted usability caveat. Confirmed on BOTH BOB lists (Wayfinder + Alterrain).
